product.olivetti-philos-33.summary: The monochrome Philos 33 combined a retractable pointer with voice recording.
product.olivetti-philos-33.history: The Philos 33 was offered in monochrome and colour. The Ivrea museum dates the family introduction to 1992, while the Historical Archive and L’Unità document its 1993 presentation.
product.olivetti-philos-33.architecture: The microphone and speaker supported recording and playback of voice notes. The PCMCIA slot could add peripherals.
product.olivetti-philos-33.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-philos-33.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-philos-33.archive: Associazione Archivio Storico Olivetti, Olivetti Philos, MAN0908.
product.olivetti-philos-33.unita: L’Unità, 8 June 1993, Olivetti portable range presentation.
product.olivetti-philos-33.museum: Muzeul de Calculatoare, Olivetti Philos 33 B/N, inventory 0093.
